text.tspan: How an LLM answers: one prefill, then many decode passes
Compute-bound: lots of maths at once
DECODE: write the answer, one token per pass
grows by one token every pass
Memory-bound: every pass re-reads all the weights
Sets the streaming speed (time per output token)
Prefill = read the question, all at once (fast). Decode = write the answer one token at a time (the slow part).
A 500-token answer = 1 prefill + about 500 decode passes.
